# Code Review

Use the shared standards and security files.

1. Inspect the diff and identify user-visible, data, and state effects.
2. Check unit, missing-data, recovery, storage, mobile, and security invariants.
3. Verify the nearest tests and remaining runtime gaps.
4. Report merge blockers before suggestions.
5. Use exact file references and an approve/block verdict.
